checks.evidence: LoginForm races the auth login promise against a 5000ms UI timeout and clears isSubmitting in finally.
On timeout, LoginForm aborts the active request, stops the spinner, and shows a retryable error message.
LoginForm uses submissionIdRef so older requests cannot close a newer submission state.
AuthProvider.login and loginRequest now accept AbortSignal and timeoutMs, passed through to apiRequest.
